title: Madeira Cake
hookLine: British-inspired madeira cake with 7 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Madeira Cake
steps.instructionTemplate: Pre-heat the oven to 180C/350F/Gas 4. Grease an 18cm/7in round cake tin, line the base with greaseproof paper and grease the paper. Cream the butter and sugar together in a bowl until pale and fluffy. Beat in the eggs, one at a time, beating the mixture well between each one and adding a tablespoon of the flour with the last egg to prevent the mixture curdling. Incorporate {m52900_1}, {m52900_2}, {m52900_3}, and {m52900_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure butter first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Madeira Cake
steps.instructionTemplate: Sift the flour and gently fold in, with enough milk to give a mixture that falls slowly from the spoon. Fold in the lemon zest. Spoon the mixture into the prepared tin and lightly level the top. Bake on the middle shelf of the oven for 30-40 minutes, or until golden-brown on top and a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean. Incorporate {m52900_5}, {m52900_6}, and {m52900_7} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Shape & Layer: Madeira Cake
steps.instructionTemplate: Remove from the oven and set aside to cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then turn it out on to a wire rack and leave to cool completely. To serve, decorate the cake with the candied peel.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Wait until the sponge feels cool to the touch before frosting so your glaze or cream stays thick and glossy.

steps.title: Cool Completely, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer Madeira Cake to a wire cooling rack and let it cool for 15–20 minutes so the interior sets cleanly without crumbling. Lift out using the parchment overhang, garnish as desired, and slice into 6 portions.
